# Zibo Hongye Vinyl Gloves

> > Leading Chinese manufacturer of disposable vinyl gloves for medical, food safety, and industrial applications, certified to BRC, ISO13485, EN455, and EN374 standards.

Zibo Hongye Shangqin Medical Science and Technology Co., Ltd., based in Shandong, China, produces powder-free and powdered vinyl gloves with certifications including BRC, ISO13485, ISO9001, CE, FDA, and NSF. The company specializes in medical examination gloves, food-grade gloves, and industrial-grade protective gloves.

- Vinyl gloves
- Powder-free vinyl gloves
- Medical examination gloves
- Food safety gloves
- Industrial-grade gloves

- ISO13485 medical device standard
- EN455 medical glove standard
- EN374 protective glove standard
- Zibo Hongye manufacturer
- Shandong China production
- Disposable gloves
- PVC glove materials
- FDA and CE compliance
- Nitrile gloves alternatives
